theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenRep_setIntegral_divergence_linear
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (S : Set (Rn N)), (∀ g h : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → HasCompactSupport h → ∫ x in S, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence (g + h) x = (∫ x in S, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g x) + ∫ x in S, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence h x) ∧ ∀ (c : ℝ) (g : Rn N → Rn N), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → ∫ x in S, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence (c • g) x = c * ∫ x in S, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g x
